output.summary: The claim was denied for a coding error and can be reconsidered if the required corrected coding submission is provided. Resubmit the claim with the corrected coding and the already‑accepted itemized bill.

items.text: Provide a corrected coding submission as required by clause 9.4 of the policy.
Resubmit the claim attaching the corrected coding submission together with the previously submitted itemized bill.
No other appeal basis is identified; the decision hinges on supplying the missing corrected coding submission.
